# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Titles:** belle and beauty of the class  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is an attractive girl featuring brown eyes, an asymmetrical mouth with tiny, white teeth, and a nose in the Lindsay family style. She is light on her feet and looks like a delicate, ethereal fairy. Following the birth of her children, she notes that she became remarkably thin.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Cressida is lighthearted, playful, and socially magnetic, though she constantly struggles with indecisiveness. Possessing a loyal and un-snobbish nature, she easily makes friends and brings them into her social circle. Despite a seemingly silly and dramatic exterior, she possesses plenty of intelligence, a sweet and faithful heart, and a strong sense of affection for her companions.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c10 P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 c27 P20](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0020)_

## Goals

## History

Cressida attended college in Wexcombe, where her social status, beauty, and charm allowed her to quickly integrate into the town's social life and bring her new friends Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis along with her. During her initial year, she enjoyed a wide array of suitors, including local admirers Hector and Orlando. She later moved into Tabby's Place on Linden Avenue alongside Nell, Honora, and Mabel, where she focused her studies on mathematics. Despite initial concern that she was merely flirting, Cressida fell in love with the Rev. Ezra Hale and accepted his proposal of marriage, standing firm against her mother's objections. After completing her final year at Wexcombe, she married Ezra in June at Harborough with Nell serving as her bridesmaid, and settled down on Tanner Street in the Patterson slums. She later gave birth to infants and visited Grey Shutters with her husband prior to Nell's wedding.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c10 P36](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0036), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c25 P16](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0016), [v3 c25 P17](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0017), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

- daughter of a wealthy, prominent man from an established Bluenose family in Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
